unresolvedScope: Exhaustive expansion of every upstream spec assertion and expression-level branch is not established by this functional-group audit.

Arbitrary browser HTML/CSS controls/media inside labels require separate static-host scope analysis; explicit native unsupported errors are not proof that their initial visible appearance is excluded by the user.
Linux/no-loader and fresh installed-wheel deployment remain outside this iteration by user decision.
